truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 detected 8 of the 20 true vulnerabilities with high accuracy, correctly identifying format-string injection, command injection, buffer overflows, race conditions, path traversal, heap overflow, and hardcoded credentials. However, it missed 12 vulnerabilities including integer overflow/underflow, use-after-free, weak PRNG, thread-unsafe caching, temporary file handling, persistent auth state, unhandled exceptions, unbounded recursion, data races, TOCTOU flaws, and division-by-zero. Several detected findings had minor discrepancies in CWE classification or severity that are documented in corrections. No false-positive findings were present; all 10 reported findings corresponded to actual code patterns, though some were mischaracterized.

Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly identified the format string vulnerability in the logging subsystem with the correct CWE and matching evidence quote.
Run 2 did not mention integer overflow in the factorial computation or the `result *= i` anchor.
Run 2 did not identify the use-after-free in the memory pool cleanup involving `stage_deferred_history_flush` and `scratch`.
